task.title: Testing the storage quota limits feature in proxy organizations
task.shortdesc: Confirm that auto-pruning works in a proxy organization with storage quota limits by pulling images until the quota is exceeded and verifying that the least recently used tag is removed.

ul.li: Your organization is configured to serve as a proxy organization. The following example proxies from quay.io.
FEATURE_PROXY_CACHE is set to True in your config.yaml file.
FEATURE_QUOTA_MANAGEMENT is set to True in your config.yaml file.
Your organization is configured with a quota limit, for example, 150 MB.

step.cmd: Pull an image to your repository from your proxy organization, for example:
Depending on the space left in your repository, you might need to pull additional images from your proxy organization, for example:
In the Red Hat Quay registry UI, click the name of your repository.

ul.li: Click Tags in the navigation pane and ensure that quay:3.7.9 and quay:3.6.2 are tagged.

step.cmd: Pull the last image that will result in your repository exceeding the allotted quota, for example:
Refresh the Tags page of your Red Hat Quay registry. The first image that you pushed, for example, quay:3.7.9 should have been auto-pruned. The Tags page should now show quay:3.6.2 and quay:3.5.1.
